Fixtures are generated at test time in pytest temporary directories. `tests/helpers.py`
creates a mixed-geometry KML, a UTM square with exactly 10,000 square metres of area,
and a nested Shapefile ZIP using the real GeoPandas/pyogrio writer. No binary fixtures
or persistent uploaded data are committed. Geographic fixtures are generated by
transforming known UTM geometries; independent geodesic comparisons also check units.
